chain.title: Inferium Essence
chain.desc: Gather Inferium from the sources available in your pack. Keep the first batch for Inferium Seeds and the Infusion Crystal so you can move from one-off gathering to renewable essence.

chain.title: Prosperity Shard
chain.desc: Mine Prosperity Ore and keep the shards for seed bases and crafting components. Prosperity and Inferium are parallel starting resources; finding one does not replace the other.

chain.title: Infusion Altar
chain.desc: Place the Infusion Altar with its surrounding Infusion Pedestals in the guide's pattern. Put the seed base in the centre and the recipe ingredients on the pedestals, then activate the altar with redstone.

chain.title: Soulstone
chain.desc: Mine Soulstone veins in the Nether (Soulium Ore spawns inside them) and smelt the cobble; the stone of the mod's soul-tech branch.

chain.title: Machine Frame
chain.desc: Craft 4 iron ingots, 4 redstone and stone; the base block of all Mystical Agriculture machines.

chain.title: Eight Ingredient Stations
chain.desc: Arrange Infusion Pedestals around the altar as shown in the guide. Each pedestal supplies one position in the seed recipe.

chain.title: Inferium Seeds
chain.desc: Plant Inferium Seeds on suitable farmland and keep harvesting the essence. Expand this supply before buying expensive tier upgrades, because each higher essence tier consumes several of the previous tier.

chain.title: Infusion Crystal
chain.desc: Use the Infusion Crystal as the catalyst for essence upgrades. The basic crystal has durability, so keep a replacement ready while building toward the Master Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Prosperity Seed Base
chain.desc: Craft 4 Prosperity Shards around Wheat Seeds; the center ingredient of every crafted resource seed.

chain.title: Growth Accelerator
chain.desc: Place Growth Accelerators below the farmland within their supported range. Build a small test column first and compare its crop growth before committing a large essence supply.

chain.title: Soulium Ingot
chain.desc: Craft a Prosperity Ingot (4 shards around an iron ingot) with 2 Soulium Dust smelted from Nether Soulium Ore.

chain.title: Tinkering Table
chain.desc: Use the Tinkering Table to fit supported augments into essence equipment. Choose upgrades that solve a current problem, such as travel or harvesting, before investing in a complete set.

chain.title: Awakening Altar
chain.desc: Build the Awakening Altar with Awakening Pedestals and Essence Vessels. Prepare the required elemental essences in advance; this process brings your crop network and equipment progression together.

chain.title: Prepare the Awakening Circle
chain.desc: Place Awakening Pedestals in the altar's required pattern. They hold the material ingredients while the Essence Vessels supply elemental essence.

chain.title: Store the Four Elements
chain.desc: Fill the Essence Vessels with the elemental essences used by your awakening recipe. Check the requested amounts before activating the altar.

chain.title: Prudentium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 2 essence: craft 4 Inferium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Soulium Dagger
chain.desc: Carry the required Soul Jars while defeating the appropriate creatures with a Soulium Dagger. Filled soul jars supply the special ingredients used by creature-based resource seeds.

chain.title: Harvester
chain.desc: Place and fuel the Harvester beside a planned crop area, then provide storage for its output. Confirm its working area and replanting behaviour before leaving it to tend your valuable seeds.

chain.title: A Place for Harvested Souls
chain.desc: Carry Soul Jars with your Soulium Dagger and inspect the creature and soul requirements for the seed you want to make.

chain.title: Tertium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 3 essence: craft 4 Prudentium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Iron Seeds
chain.desc: Complete the installed Iron Seeds infusion recipe using its seed base, essence tier and iron ingredients. Plant the result and craft the harvested Iron Essence into iron; the crop produces essence rather than ingots directly.

chain.title: Imperium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 4 essence: craft 4 Tertium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Supremium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 5 essence: craft 4 Imperium Essence around an Infusion Crystal; unlocks the highest normal seed and gear tier.

chain.title: Master Infusion Crystal
chain.desc: Upgrade to the Master Infusion Crystal once Supremium is available. It removes the basic crystal's durability bottleneck from repeated essence crafting.

chain.title: Supremium Ingot
chain.desc: Craft a Prosperity Ingot with 2 Supremium Essence; the material for tier 5 tools, armor and the upgrades fed into awakening.

chain.title: Cognizant Dust
chain.desc: Enchant an Essence weapon with Mystical Enlightenment, then use it to defeat the Wither or Ender Dragon for Cognizant Dust. Gather it for awakening recipes; the pack can configure these boss drops.
chain.acquisition: Defeat a Wither or Ender Dragon using an Essence weapon enchanted with Mystical Enlightenment. The MobDropHandler creates Cognizant Dust when that boss drop is enabled in the pack configuration.

chain.title: Awakened Supremium Essence
chain.desc: Load the awakening recipe with Supremium, Cognizant Dust and the required elemental essences. Check every vessel before starting; awakened essence is the material bridge to the final equipment tier.

chain.title: Awakened Supremium Ingot
chain.desc: Use Awakened Supremium Essence to prepare the final metal, then follow the awakening recipes for your chosen equipment. Build the piece that best supports your farm before upgrading everything at once.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Renewable essence, infusion seeds, soul harvesting, crop automation and awakening equipment.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
